title: Reseller Issuance Commitment Days
content:
Harborline's reseller issuance commitment applies to SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions held on reseller accounts. Where a multi-domain subscription's first certificate arrived after its order date, the commitment adds days to the validation-wait credit according to the tier the customer's Harborline account held on the subscription's purchase date.

**Which tier counts.** The tier is read from the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts record: the tier recorded on the account counts as the tier held on the purchase date where the date that tier took effect (the account's tier change date) is on or before the date of the subscription's purchase line. Where the recorded tier took effect after the purchase date, no commitment days are added.

**Commitment days added to the validation-wait credit**

| Tier recorded on the account | Tier took effect on or before the purchase date | Tier took effect after the purchase date |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | 3 days added | no days added |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | 3 days added | no days added |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | 2 days added | no days added |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | 2 days added | no days added |
| any other tier (Harborline Personal Account, Harborline Business Account) | no days added | no days added |

**On the boundary.** A tier that took effect on the purchase date itself counts as held on that date. A tier that took effect the day after the purchase date does not.

**Hypothetical examples** (invented accounts and dates):

- A Harborline Reseller Silver account whose tier took effect on 2 February 2032 buys a multi-domain subscription on 2 February 2032: 2 commitment days are added.
- A Harborline Reseller Gold account whose tier took effect on 9 April 2033 bought its subscription on 8 April 2033: no commitment days are added.
- A Harborline Reseller Platinum account whose tier took effect in 2030 bought its subscription in 2031: 3 commitment days are added.
- A Harborline Business Account: no commitment days are added, whatever the dates.
